name: Lynx — Canadian Large-Value Payment System
description: Lynx is Canada's RTGS (real-time gross settlement) large-value payment system, operated by Payments Canada. By-laws are public; operational and security specifications are members-only.

license.notes: By-laws are public; operational/security specs are members-only. Publicly accessible web resource with no login required (Tier 2 of Kurt Seifried 2026-11-09 4-tier hosting rule: open-web no-login content is mirrored in the public dataset repository with attribution).

lifecycle.notes: Active. Replaced LVTS in 2021. Companion systems: ACSS (retail clearing), RTR (real-time rail — in development).
